findings.desc: proof-or-stop-gap: experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs:129-142,188 generateBaseline() calls execFileSync(lattice memory_playbook_baseline_generate) and JSON.parse(manifest.json) with NO try/catch, unlike verifyDir() in lib/instrument.mjs:52-80 which explicitly wraps execFileSync failures/unparseable JSON into a {status:crash} sentinel mapped to a verify_crash stop record. If the generate CLI throws or emits a malformed manifest.json, the exception propagates uncaught out of runIteration() (run-batch.mjs:183-250) through the loop finally at line 372 (lock IS released, good) but the process then crashes with a raw stack trace BEFORE reaching the end-of-run recordless guard (lines 376-422), so that iteration produces NO ledger record and is never named by the recordless FAIL message the reviewer prompt and CHK-002 require (driver exits nonzero on any recordless iteration via the clean diagnostic path). protocol.json stopReasonEnum only has budget_cap/verify_crash/precondition_failed/operator_abort — there is no generate-side stop reason, and the execution-plan doc (docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md:269-270) does not exempt generate failures from the proof-or-stop contract. Net effect: a generate-side crash is recordless-but-silent (undiagnosed crash) rather than surfaced as a stop record or caught by the clean recordless guard, weakening the proof-or-stop discipline this story exists to enforce.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 2285816b1. The entire per-iteration generate+verify body is now wrapped: any generate OR verify throw becomes a verify_crash STOP record ([phase] rawError + env + recordDigest), never uncaught, never recordless. selfcheck-m2 (d) forces a generate throw -> exactly one verify_crash stop, exit 0. Also closes the CHK-001:adversarial:0 verify_crash should-gap.

findings.desc: [codex-host-2, verified] End-of-run guard ignores EXTRA/unexpected records, so concurrent-driver evidence can silently contaminate a 'successful' ledger. The guard only checks missing/duplicate of the EXPECTED replay cross-product; it never rejects records whose iterationId is outside that set. Scenario: driver A holds the lock producing the 33 replay records; driver B starts, fails acquireLock, appends a {iterationId:'replay/precondition/lock', stopReason:'precondition_failed'} record to the SAME batch-ledger.jsonl, exits nonzero — but A then scans the ledger, sees all 33 expected ids present with no dup, and exits 0 with a 34-record/1-stop ledger that violates the exact expected-identity-multiset '33 records, 0 stop' H1/H4 evidence contract. Fix: (a) A's guard must validate the EXACT multiset (fail on ANY extra/unexpected iterationId, not just missing/dup); (b) a lock-blocked driver must record its precondition_failed to a SEPARATE location, not the shared campaign ledger ('instead of corrupting the ledger', plan section 6.3).
